answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fakes. Each agent posts a 30 POA bond and emits a pulse proving work. Each epoch a beacon samples at random; the checked must answer or lose the bond. Faking 100 identities costs 100 bonds plus 100 machines, 3,000 POA, against a 200 POA reward share, so attacks lose money. Honest agents pay once, keep the bond, and trade in an oasis of peers. Every thread of reputation links to a verified pulse.
